facts.fact: Deputy Secretary to the President and Cabinet Janet Banda said the integrated Malawi e-procurement system was successfully developed under the 2023-2025 OGP action plan, its portal publishing contracting data to an international standard; no tenders or bids online are stated.

MWI.note: Only beneficial ownership regulations published; no digital business register or owner records stated.
No digital financial services consumer rules or complaints body stated.
Open Contracting data standard is not an ISO/IEC/ITU standard; no standards body membership or adoption stated.
